@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@[[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 1100@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@[[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] 160@@speed@@2000 • 1800@@casttime@@0.25@@cost@@50@@cooldown@@{{{cooldown}}}@@targeting@@Direction@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@special@@projectile@@True@@notes@@ * '''Amumu''' will track the target if they change locations. ** He will dash to the target's previous location if the target is 2000 or more units away or moves beyond 2000 units. * ''Bandage Toss'' will always be directed towards the target's location even if '''Amumu''' moves while it is in flight. * [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Immobilizing|An icon representing the keyword Immobilize]] [[:Crowd_control#Immobilizing|Immobilizing]] effects will not prevent '''Amumu''' from commencing the [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]]. * ''Bandage Toss'' does not fizzle on '''Amumu's''' [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|death]], and can still stun and damage enemies. * '''Amumu''' is still able to [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] even if ''Bandage Toss'' is blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]]. * '''Amumu''' will be ordered to basic attack the target upon completion of the dash. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.@@
